title: A non-technical fan privately rates the shows they went to
description: A non-technical fan (phone viewport) taps "I Was There" on a past Goose show at the Charleston Pour House, then rates it and an older show from My Shows -> Past, changes their mind, reloads, and opens a show from its row. Ratings are personal: a logged-out visitor on the show page and the Goose artist page sees no ratings, stars or review prompts anywhere. Graded against the Gardner persona's nontechnical oracles (obvious state, reload persistence, calm UI). Exercises extrachill-users private show ratings and the extrachill-events My Shows UI.
